# app-grid

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The menu-bar panel's app grid (MenuBar.Section 'apps'): every Apps.App but the current app and the home app (the desktop included: its URL is its base path as a route prefix) — as the icons DataView over the installedApp row kind, laid out as a menu's grid (viewOptions.icons.menu: four cells sharing the panel's width) (the tile and name Home and the launcher draw), each tile wearing its app's badge. Scrolling past four rows; drag reorders it, persisted per view (defineDataView('menu-bar.apps')). A tile opens its app in its own OS window through the helper (launchApp) — every app has its shim, kept by the helper ahead of any click (useNativeApps, the helper's installed set); in the default browser (openUrl) only for an app with no shim (a helper that keeps no apps); in this tab when the panel is not inside the helper. On hover a tile offers a pin (AppGridActions 'pin'): keeps the app in the Dock / GNOME dash through the helper's bridge (pinApp — a device power, never the server's) — hidden once pinned (re-read on each panel open, so it follows the Dock itself) or where the helper cannot pin, a spinner while pending, an error mark when the pin failed.
- Web:
  - Slots: `item-actions`
  - Slot contributors: `item-actions` ← `companions.menu-bar.app-grid`
  - Contributes:

    - `item-actions` "pin" → `PinAppAction`
